Type, by mood10

One recipe per project, picked from the brief's three mood words. Each recipe gives the faces (all open licence), the ladder at 1440 and 390, settings, a signature treatment and the point where it turns into slop.

Procedure and the no-reuse rule: README.md. All recipes as text: recipes.md.

Editorial

Magazines, essays, long reads, publishers.

  1. Caslon, mixed case Libre Caslon Display + Libre Caslon Text editorial-caslon-mixed · serif display, mixed-case editorial
  2. Newsroom condensed Barlow Condensed + Literata editorial-newsroom · condensed, tight setting

Technical

Developer tools, research, infrastructure.

  1. Console, tight Red Hat Text + Red Hat Text + Red Hat Mono technical-console · mono-led, tight setting
  2. Field notes, mono-led Martian Mono + Hanken Grotesk technical-field-notes · mono-led, width as hierarchy, type-only hero, no giant size

Civic and institutional

Public services, museums, universities, archives.

  1. Civic signage Overpass + Public Sans + Overpass Mono civic-signage · plain sans system, tight setting
  2. Small-caps institution Alegreya + Alegreya institution-smallcaps · small-caps system, serif display, old-style figures

Playful

Toys, games, consumer apps with a grin.

  1. Casual axis Recursive + Recursive playful-casual-axis · variable-font axis motion, kinetic type
  2. Layered sign, inline Bungee Inline + Work Sans playful-signage-inline · outline or inline, layered type

Luxury

Fashion, jewellery, hotels, fragrance.

  1. Didone, airy Bodoni Moda + Jost luxury-didone-airy · serif display, airy setting, tracked capitals
  2. Whisper, no display size Italiana + Tenor Sans luxury-whisper · type-only hero, no giant size, hierarchy by position, airy setting
Specimen copy in every recipe is placeholder text written for this library. Fonts load from Google Fonts; offline, each page falls back to system stacks.
